name: test-data-management-strategy
description: Test data management strategy — synthetic (generated via factories / faker / constraints) vs masked (from prod with PII redaction / tokenization / pseudonymization) vs subset (curated prod-like slice) vs frozen-dataset approaches. GDPR + HIPAA compliance rails (never raw prod PII in lower envs). Lifecycle: generation + seeding + reset + refresh. Determinism + reproducibility. Fixture factories + golden datasets. Storage + versioning of reference data. Env-to-env promotion. Not legal advice. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
